name: Inventory
description: Open inventory to give / take items with the player.
guided_description: Open a give/take window with the player. When the NPC agrees to hand over or receive items: a gift, payment, or a follower carrying gear.

source.description: The NPC to open their inventory.

prompt: To show the player what you have in your inventory or to give / take an item, begin your response with '{key}:'.
